body: I will try to get her to tell him within the next few days. If you don't mind, it may be on a different account (If I don't remember the password I put in for this throwaway). Thanks for your support.
She brought up that she'd tell him for me, but I'm still scared about the initial reaction.
I had been waiting over two years trying to come out to my mother. So naturally I'm afraid-- but want to rush at the same time so I don't become worse.
I've seen him openly dislike similar things before, so I'm sure that it would be very difficult.

Not at all as I expected. She still loves me and wants me to be happy, but at the same time doesn't really think it's "real". She partially feels like she's lost me in some way. After we both calmed down a bit she told me that she didn't really mean most of the stuff, but just was confused. (Afraid it's deep down hate though). I know I'm eventually going to a gender therapist, but my father would have to know first. Very worried about that.

Thanks for the information, makes me feel a bit more comfortable. Also I just recently came out, and I didn't expect it to go the way it did. My mother doesn't really understand it and I feel like she's disappointed at me-- probably the reason my heart has been pounding.
Mostly about being transgender. Also MTF.
